fixture_note: Demo away-from-screen proposals for the Japanese L0 mealtime lesson. Three proposals are derived from the reviewed lesson fixture (bundled/homework/japanese-l0-mealtime/fixture.json); one optional cafe question is authored here with its own cited sources. This file is content, not a course: it enrolls nobody, grades nothing and sends nothing.

extra_targets.register: polite (です/ます question form; author's analysis of the ending, not a dictionary label)
extra_targets.use: asked once, at a counter or a cafe, about one item

extra_tasks.title: Ask the price at one counter
extra_tasks.context: At one shop or cafe counter, about one item you can point to.
steps: Point at one item and say これはいくらですか (kore wa ikura desu ka).
Listen to the reply; you do not need to understand the number today.
If saying it out loud feels wrong today, skip this task. Skipping is honest.
extra_tasks.success_criterion: You said これはいくらですか once at a counter, about one item.

sources.title: Jisho.org — これ / 此れ
